'''Zora''', also known as '''Wraith''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[Havoc Squad]] before defecting to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Zora was a member of Havoc Squad and second-in-command to [[Harron Tavus]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" /> having been recruited directly from [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] service by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopaedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> She was the team's infiltration and assassination expert. During the war, she was stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during a [[Separatist War|civil war]], fighting the Imperial-backed [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]], where she and her squad, except an [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|unidentified Republic Trooper]], prepared and carried out their defection to the Sith Empire. Her position in Havoc Squad was filled by Aric Jorgan, soon after she defected.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />

Afterwards, Wraith captured [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Zorin Krasul]] and took him to Port Raga to force him to confess to the Senate abandoning Havoc Squad on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. The new Havoc Squad was able to rescue the Senator, though Wraith escaped, and went on to systematically eliminating the individual Havoc traitors' operations on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. These constant failures annoyed the Empire, forcing [[Harron Tavus]] to call all the Republic traitors to the Imperial warship ''Justice''. Havoc Squad infiltrated the ship, though Wraith caught them attempting to sabotage the hyperdrive. She died in the ensuing firefight.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
